stated_in.quote: Doctest exception comparison must include every exception note after the exception message, while SyntaxError-family comparisons must ignore source-location decoration but still compare the exception message and notes.

Add the regression test artifact `tests/test_doctest_notes_regression.py` covering ordinary exceptions, multiple notes, and SyntaxError-family notes. The file must be an executable standard-library unittest artifact that demonstrates the corrected comparisons.
